question.text: In a book-built issue, the price band must be announced at least __________ before the issue opening date, allowing potential investors time to evaluate the pricing.

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI requires the price band for a book-built issue to be announced at least 2 working days before the issue opens for subscription, so that investors can evaluate the pricing of the issue. The Trap: 1 working day is too short. 3 and 5 working days are longer than the SEBI-prescribed minimum. Candidates may confuse this with other IPO process timelines. Note: If the price band is revised, the issue period must be extended accordingly. The 2-working-day announcement is a minimum; issuers may announce earlier.
